title: Trajectory property gives a computation segment
statement: Let $C$ be a contract for a machine $M$ with exit set $F$, and suppose $R$ holds throughout its trajectories. For any datum $i$ and starting configuration $d$ in the entry state satisfying the precondition, the run from $d$ for the prescribed duration reaches the prescribed endpoint, its state avoids $F$ at every strictly earlier time, and $R(i,d,p)$ holds for the work-head position vector $p$ at every time up to and including that duration.
hypotheses_covered: The starting configuration is in C's entry state
The starting configuration satisfies C's precondition
replaced:
Let $C$ be a contract for a machine $M$, with entry state $e$, exit set $F$, and
trajectory predicate $R$. For any data value $i$ and starting configuration $d$ whose
state is $e$ and which satisfies the contract precondition, the run from $d$ for the
contract time reaches the contract endpoint, avoids $F$ at every earlier time, and
satisfies $R(i,d,\cdot)$ of its work-head positions at every time up to and including
that endpoint.
